name: Mailgun
summary: Mailgun Validate: single email validation with result, risk, reasons, disposable and role flags, plus the status and summaries of bulk validation and list health preview jobs. Sending is not covered.

host.description: API host: api.mailgun.net (US) or api.eu.mailgun.net for an EU account.

api_key.description: A Mailgun API key (Mailgun dashboard > API Security). Sent as HTTP Basic auth with the username 'api'.

notes: Only the Validate (address verification) API is in this entry; nothing here sends mail. Starting, promoting or cancelling bulk jobs and list health previews is left out.
Validation is limited to a set number of active requests at a time; a 429 means wait and retry.

endpoints.name: Validate one email
endpoints.summary: Result (deliverable, undeliverable, do_not_send, catch_all, unknown), risk (low, medium, high, unknown), reason list, disposable and role flags, typo suggestion, root address and engagement data.

address.description: The email address to validate, at most 512 characters.

provider_lookup.description: Let Mailgun contact the mailbox provider when its own data is not enough (default true). With false, an address it knows nothing about returns unknown with reason no_data.

notes: reason is an array: empty for a clean deliverable result, else codes such as mailbox_does_not_exist, no_mx, catch_all, accept_all, mailbox_is_disposable_address, high_risk_domain, immature_domain, smtp_timeout.

endpoints.name: List bulk validation jobs
endpoints.summary: Every bulk validation job on the account with status, quantity, records processed, counts by result, risk and engagement, and JSON/CSV download links.

endpoints.name: Get a bulk validation job
endpoints.summary: One bulk job's status, quantity, records processed, counts by result, risk and engagement, and JSON/CSV download links once done.

list_id.description: The list ID of the job.

endpoints.name: List list health preview jobs
endpoints.summary: All list health previews started on the account, with status, quantity and summary.

endpoints.name: Get a list health preview job
endpoints.summary: One list health preview: status, quantity, validity and a summary estimated from a sample of the list.
